prompts.modelSheet: Three isolated full-body front, back, and left-profile Sue views on pure magenta, with blonde bob, brown headband, teal hoodie, fish and hook patches, holographic fish/hook backpack, rolled denim shorts, mismatched red-orange and teal socks, and brown white-soled sneakers.
prompts.walkDown: Six isolated head-on front walk poses, contact/down/passing twice, with alternating limbs and stable Sue costume on pure magenta.
prompts.walkUp: Two three-frame strips generated from the approved model-sheet back-view crop: contact-left/down/passing and contact-right/down/passing, with the same oversized bob, short legs, dark green-teal hoodie, backpack, and mismatched socks.
prompts.walkLeft: Six isolated right-facing side-profile walk poses, contact/down/passing twice, with backpack and stable Sue costume on pure magenta; flopped for shipped left direction.

postProcessing.build: bun tools/art/build-sue.ts (extracts whole connected components and rebuilds the atlas)
postProcessing.extract: extract-strip.ts with connected-component extraction, expected 3 for model, 6 for front/side strips, and 3 for each back half-strip; no fixed panel crops
postProcessing.key: #FF00FF border flood plus enclosed holes, 18% fuzz, edge-only despill over a 12 px alpha-edge band
postProcessing.side: The side walk strip was generated facing right; its six extracted frames are flopped to face left. The model sheet's side view already faces left and is used as drawn for left_idle_01 (an earlier build flopped it too, so Sue turned around whenever she stopped; validate-sprite.ts now fails an idle_left that faces away from walk_left).
postProcessing.backWalk: Two selected three-frame strips are extracted separately and concatenated in cycle order. Both were generated from the approved model-sheet back-view crop.
postProcessing.despill: postprocess.ts only forwards --holes; build-sue.ts explicitly runs despill-edge.ts with magenta and band 12 after each frame, preserving other builders byte-for-byte.
postProcessing.idle: Down, up, and left idles come from the corresponding model-sheet views; up_idle_01 is the approved model-sheet back view, not a walk frame.

selectionReason: V2 model sheet and regenerated front/side strips have wide gutters and extract cleanly. Two new back half-strips were generated from the approved back-view crop, restoring the oversized bob, short legs, dark hoodie, backpack, and sock placement. Up idle is the approved model-sheet back view.
